title: 'Practice vector operations'

# 1. Get started

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here("Documents","meds","eds223","eds223-fa26","week3","data", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here("Documents","meds","eds223","eds223-fa26","week3","data", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here("Documents","meds","eds223","eds223-fa26","week3","data", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here("Documents","meds","eds223","eds223-fa26","week3","data", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```

# 2. Find bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County

Find how many bird observations are within protected areas in Santa Barbara County and show how your output differs with a spatial subset versus a spatial join

```{r}
aves_PA_subset <- sb_protected_areas[aves, ] # subset

nrow(aves_PA_subset) # 35
```

```{r}
aves_PA_join <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas)

nrow(aves_PA_join) # 103
```

```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
    tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(aves_PA_subset) +
    tm_polygons(col = 'orange',
                fill = 'orange',
                fill_alpha = 0.2) +
tm_shape(aves_PA_join) +
    tm_dots()
```

Make a 5 km buffer around the protected areas and subset buffered geometries to only those with bird observations

```{r}
PA_buffer_5km <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = units::set_units(5,'km'))

aves_buffer_subset <- PA_buffer_5km[aves, ]
```

```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
    tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(PA_buffer_5km) +
    tm_polygons(col = 'blue',
                col_alpha = 0.3,
                fill = 'blue',
                fill_alpha = 0.2) +
tm_shape(aves_PA_subset) +
    tm_polygons(col = 'orange',
                fill = 'orange',
                fill_alpha = 0.2) +
tm_shape(aves_buffer_subset) +
    tm_dots()
```

# 3. Find PAs within 15km of Goleta

Find the protected areas within 15 km of a city in Santa Barbara County

```{r}
# subset goleta
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
    filter(NAME == 'Goleta')

st_crs(goleta)$units

# create 15km buffer around goleta
goleta_buffer_15km <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = units::set_units(15,'km'))
```

```{r}
goleta_PAs_within <- st_within(sb_protected_areas,
                )
```
```{r}
tm_shape(goleta) +
    tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_polygons(col = 'orange',
                fill = 'orange',
                fill_alpha = 0.2)
```

# 4. Find distance between Goleta and Dangermond Preserve

Find the distance between your city of choice and a protected area of your choice, using the geometries’ edges and the centroid

```{r}
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |> 
    filter(UNIT_NAME == 'Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve')

solvang <- filter(sb_city_boundaries, NAME == 'Solvang')

danger_solvang_dist <- st_distance(solvang, dangermond)
danger_solvang_dist
```

```{r}
dangermond_centroid <- st_centroid(dangermond)
solvang_centroid <- st_centroid(solvang)

danger_solvang_dist_centroid <- st_distance(solvang_centroid, dangermond_centroid)
danger_solvang_dist_centroid
```
